job_spec.name: smn_fcxr2_ref_fa-r4-637a35abf
job_spec.purpose: HF-5a: native-view fix of the front_c x-write / PR1-line relay. Routed native audit of fc_xr (record 1e78e63ef, smn_fcxr_ref_fa-r2-c1dfe3d51): launch 409 ps on 2,642 xo/lo pins (budget 220) because the ONE register stage sits at the input faces (DEF: u_xd y 141-149 of 151, u_ld at li) and every output wire crosses the 151 um tile. fc_xr2 = same ports / exact pin plan / outline / recipe 2, one more stage: A at xi/li/fi faces, B at xo/lo/fo faces (reg->reg across the tile). +1 cycle on xo, lo, fo equally (fc_b xi stays aligned with li/fi); front_c calendar edge recorded in lanes/HF-5.md (HF-5a). HH-2 10-19: r1 793270d4b EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION GRT-0116 = S face (xo, 10.5 pins/um on M5 only) y 0-3 um: 2,642 FIRM BUF+HB2+BUF output stacks (3.21 um, 100% row fill) under the 26-column stage-B flop band; M3 V overflow 1,746 / total 2,795, all 746 hot gcells at y<15 um. The stage-B flops are now at the face (fc_xr had them at the far N face, so S held only the stacks). OT_OUTHOLD_FREE=1: hold pad stays one dont_touch HB2 per pin, only its location is free (m5a/m5b class). HH-10 10-19: r2 dd7fca4ca NEEDS_RTL TT +261.98 / FF -4.46 (hold ECO missed, -8.54). Classified FF hold: ALL 9 violators internal reg->reg u_xad -> u_xbd (stage A -> stage B, 97 paths < 0 ps class, worst -4.46); IO input->reg +19.64, output +39.42 (OUTHOLD_FREE did NOT strip the output pads). Cause: A->B data min 83 ps at FF vs 56 ps capture-later leaf skew (leaf_130 behind a 53 ps / 167 ps-slew clock wire at the S band); GRT repair reached +30.00 (margin 30) and sign-off lost 34.5 ps (> the 22 ps KITS figure), with NO route hold buffer left on the worst path. Fix: core reg->reg repair margin 30 -> 65 ps (route.hold_margin_ns 0.065; reg->reg setup +484 TT, so the pads are free), boundary kept at route.io_hold_margin_ns 0.03 (>= 0.025 rule; IO passed at +19.6/+39.4). Same RTL/pins/outline/SDC. TW2-NATIVE-FCX 10-19 r4: CLOSED smn_fcxr2_ref_fa-r2-dd7fca4ca-arg2 (TT +283.65 / FF +15.49) FAILS the native pin audit: launch 250.1 > 220 on 2,241 xo/lo/fo, capture 215.4 > 190 on 330 li/xi/fi, TT spread 80.1 (FF 76.0), R 267.2; O+S ~465 > 410 so no parent C passes. Classified from 6_final.def: every pin flop IS at its pin (u_xbd y 2-9 of 151 at xo, u_lbd x 213.6 at lo, u_lad/u_xad at li/xi) -- the budget is eaten by boundary HOLD padding on top of the flop: output DFF -> 2-3 route hold BUFx2 -> INV -> hold BUFx2 -> BUFx4f + HB2 pad + BUFx4f -> hold BUFx2 -> output BUFx2 (~10 cells); input HB2 pad + BUFx4f + 2-5 route hold BUFx2 (22.3k BUFx2 + 5.3k HB2 + 8.0k BUFx4f for 5,250 flops). Native receipt FF launch min 141.2 vs receiver hold need -65.7: ~200 ps over-padded (the tile-SDC sender hold skew 50 + uncertainty 25 + io margin carried on BOTH faces). Fix = recipe 4 hold_budget die (FLOW-HOLD 10-16 rule, results/arch/boundary_hold_budget_1016/RULE.md): no inhold/outhold pads, boundary min delays credit launch C=25, link skew/uncertainty are the die's; io_hold_margin 0.03 kept (KITS rule), internal reg->reg hold margin 0.065 kept (HH-10). Same RTL / outline / pins / setup SDC. Reset landing ON (gate r4a: rst_a reached 3 async flops of u_rr without a landing): reset release +2 cycles, scheduled constant; data latency unchanged.
